'''Zaprid''' was a [[black marketeer]] who operated [[Zaprid's Caravan]], a collection of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]] that traveled from backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to backwater planet. Zaprid preferred to keep the caravan away from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space.
